front: Touch a creature to disrupt body-soul connection, stunning it or forcing its soul out of its body.
back:
Fortitude save; allies can choose their degree of success.
Success: unaffected.
Failure: stunned 1.
Crit Failure: soul exits body; body stunned 1 round. Soul is aware, incorporeal, invisible, fly Speed 60 ft; can't attack, cast, or do checks needing a body; must keep line of effect to body. When stun ends, soul returns instantly.
Heightened (+3): a willing ally who chooses crit failure stays in soul form 1 more round.
